top_stories.title: Citigroup Raises Bitcoin and Ethereum Price Targets
points: Citigroup raised its 12-month Bitcoin price target 38% to $113,000 from $82,000, and its Ethereum target 37% to $3,028 from $2,240
Both targets remain below Bitcoin's October 2025 record peak

Bank cites stronger crypto market activity, a supportive macroeconomic backdrop, record M2 money supply (total dollars in circulation) expansion, and an SEC/CFTC rulemaking wave as catalysts, offsetting the Clarity Act's failure to pass the Senate

Bitcoin enters 'Uptober' (October, historically a strong month for Bitcoin) following a surprisingly positive September, with a packed economic calendar ahead: jobs report (Oct 4), FOMC minutes (Oct 8), CPI data (Oct 14), and a Fed rate decision (Oct 28)
Ethereum ETF inflows have returned, though a 9-day positive price streak ended Wednesday

unique_angles.point: Frames the M2 money supply expansion as the primary catalyst, suggesting increased monetary liquidity could flow into Bitcoin as an alternative asset
Details the specific upcoming economic calendar events and notes Ethereum ETF inflows have resumed after a brief price streak ended

items.title: Security Incidents Shake Two Major Protocols This Week
points: Near Intents protocol lost $3.8 million to a hacker exploiting a bug in its cross-chain swap mechanism, forcing a freeze on operations; the company pledged full user repayment

MetaMask exited its Ethereum validators on Lido (a liquid staking platform—lets users stake crypto and earn rewards while keeping a tradable token representing their stake) citing an infrastructure security incident, with no immediate wallet threat but a 45-day wait for withdrawn ETH due to Ethereum's unstaking mechanics

items.title: Illinois Delays Crypto Transaction Tax
points: Illinois postponed its controversial 0.2% crypto transaction tax by six months to July 2027 amid ongoing industry legal challenges

headlines: Bitcoin entering "Uptober" (historically strong October) with Citigroup raising 12-month price target to $113,000 from $82,000, citing stronger crypto activity and supportive macro backdrop

issues.subject: 🚀 Citi Says Bitcoin Is Headed to $113,000

headlines: Citibank projects Bitcoin could reach $113,000 within the next year, citing record M2 money supply (total dollars in circulation) expansion as a catalyst for price appreciation.

sections.title: Citibank's Bitcoin Price Target
points: 1. Major global investment bank Citibank published analysis forecasting Bitcoin at $113,000 over a 12-month timeframe.
2. Analysis attributes upside potential to M2 money supply hitting new all-time highs, suggesting increased monetary liquidity could flow into Bitcoin as an alternative asset.
